title: helichrysum calvertianum
intro: Helichrysum calvertianum, commonly known as African Everlasting, is a flowering plant belonging to the daisy family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and support the immune system. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a popular ingredient in natural remedies. The bioactive constituents of Helichrysum calvertianum include sesquiterpene lactones, particularly dihydro-artemisinin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
